name: lua
description: Lua interpreter and compiler for running and compiling Lua scripts

lua.description: Lua interpreter for running Lua scripts interactively or from files
lua.usage:
lua script.lua # Run script
lua -e "print('hello')" # Execute string
lua -i script.lua # Interactive after script
lua # REPL

luac.description: Lua compiler to precompile scripts into bytecode
luac.usage:
luac -o out.luac script.lua # Compile to bytecode
luac -l script.lua # List bytecode
